title: What's New: Document Reporting (2025 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Report Layouts and Word Addin Overview
Data Picker Demo: Creating Tables and Fields
Coming Next: Tooltips and Project Sequoia

features.name: Word Addin with Data Picker
features.description: New Word addin experience that allows power users and consultants to add data to document layouts through a data picker interface with a tree structure showing datasets behind reports.
caveats: This is a preview version as mentioned in the Word tab

features.name: Add Data Action in Word
features.description: New data control section in the Word addin that provides an add data action button, opening a task pane on the right with the data picker tree structure.

features.name: Add Field Functionality
features.description: Feature that allows users to add individual fields from the dataset to the Word layout by selecting add field, which inserts content controls with the field name as a tag.

features.name: Add Repeater Functionality
features.description: Feature that enables creating repeating sections in Word layouts, allowing iteration through data items like multiple customers in a table, using content controls marked as repeaters.

features.name: Simplified Word Addin Installation
features.description: Users can install the Business Central Word addin through the Office add-ins menu by searching for Business Central in the App Source, with the ability to access it either through the Home tab or File menu.
caveats: Users must select the version with AD data controls description
Multiple versions of the addin exist

features.name: Tooltips for Data Item Fields
features.description: Support for tooltips on data item fields in reports, to be added to the Word addin to make datasets more usable for non-developer users and power users.
caveats: Hopefully coming in an update in version 27 in the fall

features.name: Project Sequoia
features.description: Code name for a project focused on replacing most or all of the document layouts in Business Central to use Word layouts instead of other formats.
caveats: Office hours in fall for more details
